gpu_tip: ~76GB total at 128K context — the full-precision build. It is a sparse 3B-active MoE, so most of those weights sit idle on any given token: a 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4080) holds the always-on attention and shared layers at full speed while llama.cpp offloads the inactive experts to a 96GB DDR5 kit. The quantized builds below get close at a fraction of the memory.
mac_tip: Needs ~76GB — too much for a 64GB MacBook Pro; a 96GB or 128GB M4 Max or M5 Max fits it.
